plugins.name: clickhouse

plugins.name: cockroachdb

plugins.name: dynamodb

plugins.name: elasticsearch

plugins.name: influxdb

plugins.name: jaeger

plugins.name: kafka

plugins.name: loki
plugins.description: Loki log cockpit with labels, label values, streams, LogQL range queries, and build/status details.
